sentences.text:
The petitioner in the instant writ petition has prayed for setting aside the preliminary notification
and the final notification pertaining to 2 Acres 25 Guntas of land in Survey No.44/1 of Haralur
u Village, Channarayapatna Hobli, Devanahalli Taluk.

2. The case of the petitioner is that he is the owner of the land mentioned above and the same has been acquired by the State for the purpose of respondent No.2- Karnataka Industrial Area,
Sri M Rajanna vs State Of Karnataka on 12 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/87581777/
2 Development Board, who in turn has allotted the same in favour of respondent No.5- Center for Educational and Social Studies, (Chanakya University).

entities.text: Center for Educational and Social Studies
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: His submission is that respondent No.5 is an Educational Institution and it could not have been allotted land which was acquired for industrial purposes.
It is also contended that his objections have not been properly considered by the Special Land Acquisition Officer at the time of rejecting the same.

On the said ground, it is NC:
2024:KHC:5870 prayed that the notifications acquiring the said lands be set aside.

3. Per contra, the learned counsel for the respondents submits that the land of the petitioner is agricultural in nature and they were notified for acquisition for industrial purposes and the objections filed by the petitioner have been considered in accordance with law and the same has been rejected and thereafter a final notification has been passed.

4. It is further submitted that by a notification dated 18.03.1991, Educational Institutions are considered as amenities in the industrial area and the industrial land can be allotted to the Educational Institutions.

5. It is also submitted that under Section 2(7a) of the Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Act ('the KIAD Act' for short) Industrial Infrastructure and Facilities are defined and its reads as under:
'2[(7-a) "Industrial Infrastructural facilities" means facilities which contribute NC:
2024:KHC:5870 to the development of industries established in industrial area such as research and development, communication, transport, Banking, Marketing,
Technology parks and Townships for the purpose of establishing trade and tourism centres; and any other facility as the State Government may by notification specify to be an industrial infrastructural facility for the purposes of this Act;]'
6.

It is submitted that the land can be allotted for Industrial Infrastructure Facilities and respondent No.5- Center for Educational and Social Studies, (Chanakya University) also intends to establish research and development facilities in respect of various subjects that will boost the development of industries in the State and for that reasons, the land has been allotted to respondent No.5.

entities.text: Center for Educational and Social Studies
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text:
For the said reasons, the respondents prayed that the writ petition be dismissed.
7.
Admittedly, the preliminary notification has been issued as contemplated under the provisions of the KIAD Act.
Objections have been called for from the notified NC: 2024:KHC:5870 khatedars of the lands that were sought to be acquired.

The petitioner has filed his objections before respondent No.3 -Special Land Acquisition Officer, wherein the only objection raised by him is that the land is agricultural in nature and he requires the same for his purposes and it should not be acquired.
As the land was required for industrial purposes, his objections have been considered and rejected in accordance with law and a final notification has been passed.

Thereafter, the concerned land has been allotted in favour of respondent No.5- Center for Educational and Social Studies, (Chanakya University), which admittedly intends to have research, development and training departments as part of the university and as per the notification dated 18.03.1991, issued under Section 2(1) of the KIAD Act, Educational Institutions are considered as an amenity and land can be allotted in favour of the Educational Institution by respondent Nos.1 and 2.
